headline: Fronts Stir as Gutter Joins Contested Belt
war_summary: The latest returns show the contested belt widening, with Gutter now the busiest immediate front. It recorded 13 strategic-base events in the past two hours and 19 across the day, while its holdings stand at six Colonial and one Warden base; casualty traffic remains heavy, though both recent rates are cooling. PalantineBerm logged four fresh events and 31 in 24 hours, with two Warden, three Colonial, and two neutral positions. WeatheredExpanse saw six events in two hours and 22 during the day, now holding four Warden, three Colonial, and two neutral bases amid substantial but recently cooling losses. LinnMercy added two events, with eight Colonial, two Warden, and one neutral base. MarbanHollow and NevishLine each remain active, recording one and two events respectively in the latest two hours. NevishLine’s casualty rates are accelerating on both sides, while Marban’s recent traffic is easing. Godcrofts, once the day’s busiest sector, has gone quiet in the latest window; CallahansPassage still carries enormous casualty totals without recorded base movement. No victor is declared.
